# Voyages Counseling

> A Colorado-based mental health practice offering therapy services across multiple locations with specializations in trauma, ADHD, couples counseling, and innovative treatments like neurofeedback.

Voyages Counseling operates multiple therapy locations throughout Colorado including Centennial, Central Park, Colorado Springs, Castle Rock, and Lone Tree, plus telehealth services extending to Kansas. The practice emphasizes evidence-based treatments and personalized mental health care.

## Key Topics

- Counseling Services
- Trauma Therapy
- EMDR
- Couples Therapy
- Family Therapy
- Neurofeedback Therapy
- ADHD Counseling
- Psychiatric Care
- Mental Health Services
- Telehealth
- Colorado Springs
- Christian Counseling
- Therapist Directory
- Mental Wellness

## Core Services & Specializations

- [Trauma Therapy for Healing | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/trauma-therapy-voyages-counseling): Trauma therapy using EMDR and ART techniques for healing
- [Relationship Counseling | Voyages Counseling Colorado](https://www.myvc.org/relationship-counseling): Couples and relationship counseling for conflict resolution
- [Neurofeedback Therapy | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/neurofeedback-therapy): Neurofeedback and brain training therapy for mental wellness
- [ADHD Counseling for Adults | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/adhd-counseling): ADHD counseling for adults with symptom management strategies
- [Psychiatric Care in Colorado | Telehealth Medication Management | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/psychiatric-care): Psychiatric care and medication management by PMHNP-BC provider
- [Christian Counseling Services in Colorado | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/christian-counseling-colorado): Faith-based therapy integrating Christian principles in Colorado

## Locations & Access

- [Voyages Counseling: Locations & Directions](https://www.myvc.org/locations): All office locations and directions across Colorado locations
- [Colorado Springs Counseling & Therapists | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/colorado-springs-counseling): Colorado Springs location with individual, couples, and family therapy
- [Centennial Counseling Services | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/centennial-counseling): Centennial location with therapist directory and mental health services
- [Central Park Counseling Services | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/central-park-colorado): Central Park location with family and trauma therapy services
- [Castle Rock Counseling Services | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/castle-rock-counseling): Castle Rock location services with therapist profiles and offerings
- [Lone Tree Counseling Services in Colorado | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/lone-tree-counseling): Lone Tree location featuring neurofeedback therapy and counseling
- [Telehealth Counseling | Voyages Counseling Colorado](https://www.myvc.org/telehealth-counseling): Virtual therapy sessions and telehealth counseling services
- [Telehealth Kansas | Voyages Counseling Colorado](https://www.myvc.org/kansas): Telehealth services available to Kansas clients via virtual sessions

## Specialized Therapy Services

- [Family Counseling in Castle Rock - Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/family-counseling-castle-rock): Family counseling services in Castle Rock for relationship growth
- [Child Therapist in Colorado Springs | Voyages Counseling](https://www.myvc.org/child-therapist-colorado-springs): Child therapy services in Colorado Springs with coping strategies
